View 2814 West 3rd Avenue, Vancouver, BC V6K 1M7, CA rent availability, including the monthly rent price, and browse photos of this 2 beds, 1 bath, 950 sqft apartment. 2814 West 3rd Avenue, Vancouver, BC V6K 1M7, CA offers studio, 1 bedroom, 2 bedroom and 3+ bedroom apartments for rent or lease. There are currently 3 units listed for rent at 2814 West 3rd Avenue, Vancouver, BC V6K 1M7, CA.
In the heart of Kitsilano!   Total top floor of the Manor with great views on all sides with complete privacy.  This two bedroom 950 sq. ft. fully furnished executive Penthouse suite is in the heart of Kitsilano at West 4th and Macdonald, just 2 short blocks from the beach.
Beautiful, hardwood floor apartment featuring granite kitchen with stainless steel appliances and Nespresso machine.  The 12 foot ceilinged living room has a lovely large supple leather sectional sofa, gas fireplace, skylight and outdoor deck facing to the sunny south. For entertainment, there is a  46" flat screen TV.  The master bedroom and second bedroom feature queen size, ultra luxury Stearns and Foster mattresses.  The master bedroom also has a large openable skylight for great ventilation.  Dining area just off the kitchen has a  lovely round dining table.  Suite has three large skylights offering fresh air and breezes. Windows open on all sides for maximum ventilation and cooling throughout the year.   Architectural ceilings and skylights provide beautiful bright lighting.  The apartment features lovely views to the Burrard inlet and Northshore mountains.
Laundry facilities in building.

2 short blocks to the beach, through Tatlow Park, near shops and many restaurants all in walking distance.  Fantastic walking area along the beach and many parks.  A great summer getaway!

NOTE:  Our Vancouver furnished apartments are located in a modernized character home with a touch of 1912 class just 2 blocks from the ocean.

Many of our guests, who book our furnished suites in Vancouver, include visiting professors at UBC, doctors here for sabbatical and exchange programs at Vancouver General Hospital (VGH), St. Paul’s and UBC hospital, business people here for extended contracts, parents of university students living in student accommodation, parents of children about to have their first baby, wedding guests, pre and post cruise guests, returning Vancouver residents, new immigrants, people undergoing renovations or insurance claims, patients and their families under going medical treatment…..and vacationers of all ages.

Come stay with us at Alma Beach Suites, your home away from home! We look forward to making your stay with us a memorable one as you explore beautiful Vancouver!
